top_findings.title: Aggregate queries silently truncated to 100 matches by search_matches default limit
top_findings.evidence: lib/brazilian_soccer.ex:19 `Enum.take(Map.get(opts, :limit, 100))`; standings/3 (l.126), team_statistics/3 (l.26), competition_statistics/2 (l.139) and head_to_head/4 (l.78) all call search_matches with no explicit limit, so a full Brasileirao season (~380 matches) or league-wide average is computed from only the 100 most-recent matches. Tests pass (l.73) only because the fixture has 3 matches.
top_findings.suggestion: Apply the display limit only in search_matches' user-facing path; have the aggregate helpers query the unfiltered match list (e.g. an internal filter that omits the take) so standings/stats span the full season.
